metadata.title: World Digest — November 1, 2026
metadata.summary: A historic AI rout erased $5 trillion from tech shares as Alphabet lost $500 billion, while European youth protests turned violent in Frankfurt and France.

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Tensions Dominate as Europe Sees Unrest

Youth-led protests turned violent across Europe, with riots in Frankfurt and clashes in France over living costs and military service Financial Times CNBC. In Poland, PM Tusk vowed to press on with overhauling the judiciary amid a court standoff Financial Times. Beijing expelled a record 33 officials as a purge deepens NPR. Meanwhile, Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot opened coalition talks with Arab parties Yahoo. Negotiators continued US-Iran talks amid war rhetoric Al Jazeera, as Bulgaria held a presidential runoff AP News.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Reel as AI Rout Erases Trillions

Global markets were dominated by a historic tech selloff. Alphabet suffered its worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value Barron's, contributing to a broader crash that wiped out $2 trillion from U.S. stocks Yahoo Finance and $5 trillion from AI shares Yahoo Finance. Bond investors sat out the midterms Financial Times. Meanwhile, Binance resumed withdrawals after a $6.3 billion hack CBS News, and OPEC+ held output steady Reuters. South Korea’s exports surged 93.7% on AI chip demand WSJ.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: ‘SNL’ honored the late Patrick Stewart with a 1994 clip tribute Deadline. Inde Navarrette’s Halloween episode, featuring a viral robot sketch Variety and a Trump-crashed David S. Pumpkins cold open Rolling Stone, won the night. Netflix’s Brad Pitt film Cliff Booth was rejected by Regal and Cinemark MovieWeb. Michael Mann accidentally shot himself in the leg TMZ, while Michael Douglas says Jack Nicholson is "well" but "disappeared" The Hollywood Reporter.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • Grizzlies 136, Kings 105 – Memphis stays unbeaten at 6-0 as Boozer and Stewart lead the rout ESPN.
  • Spurs 121, Timberwolves 111 – Wembanyama erupts for a season-high 43 points on a career-best 34 shots, adding six blocks ESPN ESPN.
  • Rockets 119, Thunder 98 – Jabari Smith Jr. scores 30 as Houston improves to 6-1 ESPN.

Hockey

  • Bruins 5, Blackhawks 4 (OT) – Lindholm’s overtime winner lifts Boston; Pastrnak passes Bergeron on a scoring list ESPN.
  • Oilers 4, Islanders 0 – McDavid extends his assist streak to 14 games in the shutout win ESPN.
  • Senators 5, Sharks 1 – Ottawa ties a franchise record with nine October wins ESPN.

Baseball

  • Rays pick up $20M option on Drew Rasmussen – Tampa locks in its ace for 2027 ESPN.
  • Orioles decline Luis Robert’s $20M option – Baltimore moves on from the outfielder ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Gunnison Copper (NYSE American), MSG Rangers (NYSE), Georgia Banking (Nasdaq), Aspen Neuroscience, Bambusa Therapeutics, Nordicus Partners (Nasdaq) all priced 10/26–10/30 with prices not set [2-7]. OPay listed on NYSE at $19 on 10/30 Yahoo Finance. Narragansett Bancorp (Nasdaq, 11/2) and Deep Sea Minerals (Nasdaq, 11/3) upcoming [9-10].

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 1.82% to 7,580.07; Nasdaq dropped 2.86% to 25,437.00 Yahoo Finance. Dow lost 1.09%; Russell 2000 slid 1.66% Yahoo Finance. VIX jumped 12.91% to 19.42 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Energy led, +1.91%; Consumer Staples +1.41% Yahoo Finance. Technology lagged sharply at -4.89%; Industrials -1.60% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Nvidia fell 4.22% to $204.64; Broadcom dropped 5.48% Yahoo Finance. Apple -1.23%, Microsoft -1.55% Yahoo Finance. Berkshire rose 0.10% Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Top gainers: CareDx +22.2%, FedEx Freight +14.9% [11-12]. Top losers: Reddit -29.2%, Intel -28.6% [16-17]. Most active: Nvidia, SpaceX -6.4% [21-22].

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield fell 1.20% to 4.93% Yahoo Finance. WTI crude rose 2.08% to $104.12; gold fell 3.29% Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin edged up 0.31% Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • US-Iran talks may yield headlines as war rhetoric persists; any breakdown could spike oil above $104.
  • AI selloff may extend; watch Nvidia and Alphabet for stabilization signals after historic losses.
  • Binance withdrawal resumption could face further stress tests post-$6.3B hack.

Next Week

  • Deep Sea Minerals and Narragansett Bancorp IPOs may test risk appetite amid volatility.
  • European protest momentum could widen if governments delay cost-of-living responses.

Next Month

  • OPEC+ steadiness may erode if oil sustains $100+; Korea’s AI-driven export surge likely continues.
